item: The release-notes gate judges a row's refs by the same predicate as the fragment check
summary: release_notes.refuse_placeholders tested the substring pending in a cited row's refs, so a row citing #NNNN or #PRNUMBER went into a release body while ledger_shipped.py check refuses both, and 'depending on #1637' was refused at tag time by a rule the fragment check never applied. refs_carry_placeholder now reads ledger_shipped.REFS_PLACEHOLDER through one cached loader and the refusal names the three tokens; 0 of 1,677 real rows differ between the two predicates. 9 new tests are red on the old script and one source-following test is the only one that kills a private copy of the regex.
